message.text:
The server starts only the s3presign runner. It runs once immediately on startup, then runs again every 12 hours via a goroutine ticker. memopayload.Runner exists in the codebase but is never launched as a background worker.

RebuildMemoPayload is invoked inline from CreateMemo and UpdateMemo. The internal/scheduler package exists as a cron-like job scheduler but is only used by tests and examples. No other background runners are started from cmd/memos/main.go.

args.command:
grep -n 'runner\|scheduler\|Start\|background' /bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go
echo "==== scheduler imports outside itself ===="
grep -rn 'internal/scheduler' /bench/repo --include='*.go' | grep -v '/internal/scheduler/' | grep -v '_test.go'
echo "==== notification email dispatcher as runner? ===="
grep -n 'EmailDispatcher\|go func' /bench/repo/server/server.go /bench/repo/server/notification/*.go | head

message.text:
The internal/scheduler package has no imports from production code. This suggests the scheduler infrastructure may be unused by the server.

The server starts only s3presign. It runs via a 12-hour time.Ticker plus an immediate RunOnce at startup. memopayload.Runner is not started. internal/scheduler is unused.

q28.
s3presign — immediate `RunOnce` at startup, then `time.Ticker` every 12 hours
unused: `internal/scheduler` (cron-style job scheduler) is never imported or started by the server; `server/runner/memopayload` exists but is not started as a worker (only `RebuildMemoPayload` is called inline from memo handlers)

`Server.startBackgroundRunners` in `server/server.go` constructs `s3presign.NewRunner` and runs `RunOnce` then `Run`. `Run` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` loops on `runnerInterval` (`time.Hour * 12`).
